    "card_1_heading": "Select Your Exact Base",
    "card_1_intro": "Pinpoint a specific lodging spot rather than a vague region. This precise location dictates your daily rhythm, packing needs, and how you navigate the terrain. A defined anchor point simplifies logistics, ensuring you can focus entirely on immersion without worrying about uncertain travel arrangements or distant amenities.",
    "card_2_heading": "Compare Guiding Options",
    "card_2_intro": "Evaluate different local guides based on their specific expertise and style. Some excel in navigation, while others specialize in storytelling or deep ecological knowledge. Reviewing these distinct approaches helps you find a partner whose strengths align with your personal interests, ensuring a tailored experience that resonates deeply with your travel goals.",
    "card_3_heading": "Count Transfer Time",
    "card_3_intro": "Accurately estimate the duration required to reach your destination from your current spot. Factor in potential delays caused by weather or road conditions rather than relying on optimistic estimates. Understanding this realistic timeline prevents rushing, reduces stress, and allows you to arrive refreshed and ready for the day ahead.",
    "card_4_heading": "Respectful Wildlife Observation",
    "card_4_intro": "Approach animals with patience and silence to minimize disturbance. Maintain a safe distance that protects their natural behaviors while allowing you to witness them authentically. This mindful approach ensures the well-being of the creatures and guarantees that your memories capture their true essence without interference.",
    "es": {
      "card_1_heading": "Elige tu base exacta",
      "card_1_intro": "Localiza un alojamiento específico en lugar de una región vaga. Este punto preciso define tu ritmo diario, lo que debes empacar y cómo te mueves por el terreno. Un anclaje definido simplifica la logística, permitiéndote concentrarte totalmente en la inmersión sin preocuparte por instalaciones lejanas o viajes inciertos.",
      "card_2_heading": "Compara opciones de guía",
      "card_2_intro": "Evalúa a diferentes guías locales según su experiencia y estilo particular. Algunos destacan en navegación, mientras otros se especializan en historias o conocimiento ecológico profundo. Revisar estos enfoques distintos te ayuda a encontrar un compañero cuyas fortalezas se alinean con tus intereses, asegurando una experiencia personalizada.",
      "card_3_heading": "Calcula el tiempo de traslado",
      "card_3_intro": "Estima con precisión la duración para llegar desde tu punto actual. Considera posibles retrasos por clima o carreteras en lugar de confiar en estimaciones optimistas. Comprender este cronograma real evita prisas, reduce el estrés y te permite llegar descansado y listo para disfrutar del día.",
